evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/migrate.cpp` along with wallet migration tests.
rationale: Hardens the wallet migration BDB parser against crafted or corrupted files that trigger infinite loops or severe memory exhaustion. The PR description notes that on master an ~8 KB crafted file causes the parser to hang indefinitely without finishing, and a 256 KB file inflates memory usage from 54 MB to ~800 MB.
